`rust/lichen-schc/fuzz/fuzz_targets/fuzz_fragment.rs:7`

## Bug
In this commit, the fuzz target was changed from:
```rust
let mut tile = [0u8; TILE_SIZE];
let _ = Fragment::from_bytes(data, &mut tile);
```
to:
```rust
let _ = Fragment::from_bytes(data);
```

But `Fragment::from_bytes` at `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:175` has signature:
```rust
pub fn from_bytes(data: &[u8], out: &'a mut [u8]) -> Result<Self, FragmentError>
```
which requires 2 arguments (the `out` mutable slice for the payload). Calling it with only 1 argument will fail to compile.

## Severity
P0 - build error in fuzz target. The fuzzer cannot be built/run.
